title: Tideglusib-incorporated nanofibrous scaffolds potently induce odontogenic differentiation.
authors: Tabassum, Nadia; Khalid, Saira; Ghafoor, Sarah; Woo, Kyung Mi; Lee, Eun Hye; Samie, Muhammad; Konain, Kiran; Ponnusamy, Sasikumar; Arany, Praveen; Rahman, Saeed Ur
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Tideglusib负载纳米纤维支架促进成牙本质分化，涉及分子对接但对象为GSK-3β小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pulp-Dentin regeneration is a key aspect of maintain tooth vitality and enabling good oral-systemic health. This study aimed to investigate a nanofibrous scaffold loaded with a small molecule i.e. Tideglusib to promote odontogenic differentiation. Tideglusib (GSK-3beta inhibitor) interaction with GSK-3beta was determined using molecular docking and stabilization of beta-catenin was examined by confocal microscopy. 3D nanofibrous scaffolds were fabricated through electrospinning and their physicochemical characterizations were performed. Scaffolds were seeded with mesenchymal stem cells or pre-odontoblast cells to determine the cells proliferation and odontogenic differentiation. Our results showed that Tideglusib (TG) binds with GSK-3beta at Cys199 residue. Stabilization and nuclear translocation of beta-catenin was increased in the odontoblast cells treated with TG. SEM analysis revealed that nanofibers exhibited controlled architectural features that effectively mimicked the natural ECM. UV-Vis spectroscopy demonstrated that TG was incorporated successfully and released in a controlled manner. Both kinds of biomimetic nanofibrous matrices (PCLF-TG100, PCLF-TG1000) significantly stimulated cells proliferation. Furthermore, these scaffolds significantly induced dentinogenic markers (ALP, and DSPP) expression and biomineralization. In contrast to current pulp capping material driving dentin repair, the sophisticated, polymeric scaffold systems with soluble and insoluble spatiotemporal cues described here can direct stem cell differentiation and dentin regeneration. Hence, bioactive small molecule-incorporated nanofibrous scaffold suggests an innovative clinical tool for dentin tissue engineering.
abstract_zh: 牙髓-牙本质再生是维持牙齿活力及促进口腔-全身健康的关键方面。本研究旨在探索一种负载小分子Tideglusib的纳米纤维支架，以促进成牙本质细胞分化。通过分子对接 (molecular docking) 确定Tideglusib（GSK-3β抑制剂）与GSK-3β的相互作用，并利用共聚焦显微镜 (confocal microscopy) 检测β-catenin的稳定性。通过静电纺丝 (electrospinning) 制备三维纳米纤维支架，并对其理化特性进行表征。将间充质干细胞或前成牙本质细胞接种于支架上，以评估细胞增殖和成牙本质分化。结果表明，Tideglusib（TG）与GSK-3β在Cys199残基处结合。经TG处理的成牙本质细胞中，β-catenin的稳定性和核转位增加。扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 分析显示，纳米纤维表现出可控的结构特征，有效模拟了天然细胞外基质 (ECM)。紫外-可见光谱 (UV-Vis spectroscopy) 证实TG成功负载并以受控方式释放。两种仿生纳米纤维基质（PCLF-TG100、PCLF-TG1000）均显著促进细胞增殖。此外，这些支架显著诱导牙本质形成标志物（ALP、DSPP）表达及生物矿化。与当前驱动牙本质修复的牙髓覆盖材料相比，本文所述具有可溶性和不溶性时空线索的精密聚合物支架系统可引导干细胞分化和牙本质再生。因此，负载生物活性小分子的纳米纤维支架为牙本质组织工程提供了一种创新性临床工具。
